'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Brandon Stern LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Stern]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
